features.name: Martial Arts
features.desc: Your Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons use Dexterity, deal damage using your Martial Arts die (which increases with level: d6/d8/d10/d12), and let you make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.desc: Without armor or a Shield, your AC = 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Focus Points
features.desc: You gain Focus Points equal to your Monk level. You spend them on special techniques; you regain them when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.desc: Your Speed increases while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield: +10 feet (increasing to +30 feet).

features.name: Heightened Metabolism
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, when you start combat with 0 Focus Points, you regain 1 point and heal yourself for {monkHeal2} Hit Points (2 × Monk level).

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.desc: As a Reaction, you reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from an attack by 1d10 {dexMod} (Dex) +{level} (level); by spending 1 Focus Point, you redirect the remaining damage to a creature within 5 feet (Dexterity saving throw).

features.name: Slow Fall
features.desc: As a Reaction, you reduce falling damage by five times your Monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You make two attacks when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.desc: When you hit with a melee attack, you can spend 1 Focus Point: the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Empowered Strikes
features.desc: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Force damage instead of their normal damage type.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.desc: Your Speed bonus increases to +15 feet.

features.name: Evasion
features.desc: When you make a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage: on a success, you take no damage; on a failure, you take half.

features.name: Acrobatic Movement
features.desc: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids without falling.

features.name: Heightened Focus
features.desc: Flurry of Blows grants 3 strikes; Patient Defense grants Temporary Hit Points; Step of the Wind can also move an ally.

features.name: Self-Restoration
features.desc: At the start of your turn, you can end one condition on yourself for free (Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned); you don't need food or drink.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.desc: Deflect Attacks can reduce damage of any type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Thunder, etc.).

features.name: Disciplined Survivor
features.desc: You gain proficiency in all saving throws. By spending 1 Focus Point, you reroll a failed saving throw.

features.name: Perfect Focus
features.desc: When you start combat with fewer than 4 Focus Points, you regain points until you have 4.

features.name: Superior Defense
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you spend 3 Focus Points: for 1 minute, you have Resistance to all damage types except Force.

features.name: Body and Mind
features.desc: Dexterity and Wisdom +4 (maximum 25).
